text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: The last token, at the layer before the answer where the lens reads the entity best
Read: a probe's accuracy on the lens part of the last token's state (dotted: chance). Swap: the lens swap's
switches as a share of the whole-state patch's at the same layer. Whiskers: 95% intervals.
Lightning: read bars hatched, swap bars dashed: its gate chosen after the 60-scene pre-check was seen.
